card.name: Start of the word resuscitation
card.fires_on: The piece "res" (or "RES") that begins resuscitation or rescue, usually after emergency, cardiac or cardiopulmonary in warnings about having equipment ready.

modes.label: Resuscitation equipment warnings
modes.description: "res" after emergency, cardiac or cardiopulmonary, before "uscitation" in a statement about equipment and trained staff being available.
modes.example: Always have emergency<< res>>uscitation equipment and trained personnel available.

modes.label: Rescue and other uses
modes.description: "RES" or "res" starting resuscitation or rescue in headings and other drug-label phrases.

card.writes: It suppresses rescue, first and emergency words, so it seems to cancel those continuations after the start of resuscitation or rescue.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of "resuscitation" in warnings to keep emergency equipment on hand.
